research_rationale:
Executive Order 10982 of December 25, 1961 (27 FR 3; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10982.txt, read in full, characters 540-5550) administers the Act of September 26, 1961 on evacuation payments. The packet's ten machine clauses did not follow the sections; I read the whole order and replaced them by twelve clauses: the recital, 1(a), 1(b), 1(c), 2(a), 2(b), the section 3 lead, 3(a), 3(b), 3(c), 4(a) and 4(b). Later instruments, both official texts held in the packet: Executive Order 12107 (December 28, 1978, effective January 1, 1979), which substitutes the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission in the listed orders, including this one (listed as '19982' in the scan, an OCR error), recorded on each clause that names the Commission; and Executive Order 12748 section 5 (signed February 1, 1991, effective May 4, 1991 by default under its section 9(b)), which restates section 2(b). The Code note at 5 U.S.C. 5527 prints the order as amended by both, and 28 CFR 0.154 and 5 CFR part 550 cite it. None of these ends any clause. Not held in the packet: the text of 5 U.S.C. 5522-5527 beyond the note and the later OPM regulations (5 CFR part 550 subpart D is held in the repo but not in the packet); the claim rests on the Code's printing of the order and the eCFR citations.
